id: \bI'm the strongest of the family. Think you can win?
en: \bI'm the strongest of the family. Think you can win?
it: \bSono il più forte della famiglia. Pensi di potermi battere?

id: \bHere, have this as a reward for being so strong.
en: \bHere, have this as a reward for being so strong.
it: \bEcco, prendi questo come ricompensa per essere così forte.

id: \bA Macho Brace doubles any effort values the Pokémon holding it gets, but halves its Speed in battle, so be careful.
en: \bA Macho Brace doubles any effort values the Pokémon holding it gets, but halves its Speed in battle, so be careful.
it: \bUn Crescicappa raddoppia i punti base che ottiene il Pokémon che lo tiene, ma dimezza la sua Velocità in lotta, quindi fai attenzione.

id: \rYou look exhausted. Why don't you take a break.
en: \rYou look exhausted. Why don't you take a break.
it: \rSembri esausto. Perché non ti riposi un po'?

id: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
en: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.  Take care now!
it: \rOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto. Abbi cura di te!

id: \rI may be young but I'm stronger than what you have already won.
en: \rI may be young but I'm stronger than what you have already won.
it: \rSarò anche giovane, ma sono più forte di quelli che hai già battuto.

id: \rThe next two are the real challenge.
en: \rThe next two are the real challenge.
it: \rI prossimi due sono la vera sfida.

id: \bI'm the first of the Winstrate family. Think you can win?
en: \bI'm the first of the Winstrate family. Think you can win?
it: \bSono il primo della famiglia Vincenti. Credi di poter vincere?

id: \bGreat battle. Good luck with the rest.
en: \bGreat battle. Good luck with the rest.
it: \bGran bella lotta. Buona fortuna con il resto.

id: \rI'm going to be a bit harder.
en: \rI'm going to be a bit harder.

id: \rI'm surprised you made it this far. Though you won't be going any farther.
en: \rI'm surprised you made it this far. Though you won't be going any farther.
it: \rSono sorpresa che tu sia arrivato fin qui. Ma più in là non andrai.

id: \rWhat a wonderful battle. I haven't had a challenge like that in ages.
en: \rWhat a wonderful battle. I haven't had a challenge like that in ages.
it: \rChe lotta meravigliosa. Era da secoli che non avevo una sfida del genere.
